root_causes.description: The cart service shows an abnormally large container memory working set (mean ~93 MB, peaking ~108 MB) versus ~24 MB for peer leaf services (checkout, product-catalog), together with container restart activity, consistent with a memory-stress fault injected into cart.

evidence.expected_baseline: ~24-25 MB working set (checkout=24669661.867 B, product-catalog=24191249.067 B)

evidence.observed_value: cart pod container Created/Started events with count=2
evidence.expected_baseline: no container recreate events during normal operation

root_causes.description: Cart server-side p99 latency spikes to ~78 ms (median ~4 ms) during the incident window, a secondary effect of memory pressure/GC on the cart container.

Frontend and checkout depend on cart (frontend → cart, checkout → cart); memory pressure in cart could degrade these upstream callers, but no cart server errors were observed, making this the least supported explanation.

evidence.expected_baseline: no error traces expected for healthy cart

remediation_steps: Increase the cart container memory limit/request and verify OOM/GC behavior for the cart deployment in namespace otel-demo.
Rolling-restart the cart pods to clear pressured memory and confirm the working set returns to the ~24 MB peer baseline.
Add a memory-usage alert on container_memory_working_set_bytes for cart and monitor p99 latency of upstream callers (frontend, checkout) for recurrence.
